how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-ashenvale-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:2:obj:0: Bring Sharptalon's ⟦E1⟧ to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:2:details:0: The mighty hippogryph Sharptalon has been slain, with the claw of the felled beast serving as a testament to your victory. Senani Thunderheart at the Splintertree Post will no doubt be interested in seeing this trophy as proof of your deeds.
rows.quest:2:completion:0: Most impressive, ⟦1⟧... the claw of Sharptalon could not have been easy to get! The ⟦E2⟧ Hunt goes well for you!
rows.quest:2:completion:1: BSharptalon had long terrorized the peons from the lumber camps near its path as they tried to travel here to Splintertree Post. No doubt once the word gets out that it was you who put down the beast, many rousing songs of your bravery will be heard at campfires and lumber mills across ⟦E2⟧!
rows.quest:23:obj:0: Bring Ursangous's Paw to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:23:details:0: The paw of the mighty bear Ursangous is your trophy for this part of the ⟦E2⟧ Hunt. On the paw is a small quarter-crescent emblem; the significance of the emblem remains a mystery.
rows.quest:23:details:1: BThe paw should be brought to Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post to prove that you have bested the mighty creature and completed this portion of the hunt.
rows.quest:23:completion:0: Ah, the paw of Ursangous! Your skill is impressive, ⟦2⟧; he is credited with numerous kills. The crescent on his paw is no doubt a sign that he was trained by the night elves that skulk about ⟦E2⟧. Ursangous is... was one of the mightiest bears you'd find in these parts. To have bested such a creature is a testament to your will and resolve.
rows.quest:24:obj:0: Bring Shadumbra's Head to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:24:details:0: The once swift Shadumbra now lies still as you claim victory over it. The head of the slain nightsaber is a fitting trophy for this fight of the ⟦E2⟧ Hunt. Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post will want to see such a trophy to award you credit for this part of the ⟦E2⟧ Hunt.
rows.quest:24:completion:0: A victory for ⟦3⟧ in the ⟦E2⟧ Hunt! Well done - the head of Shadumbra is a fitting trophy to claim for such an impressive fight, no doubt.
rows.quest:24:completion:1: BShadumbra's savagery was well known throughout the post here. Any trip to the west, especially on foot trying to get out to the Zoram Strand, was wrought with danger because of this tiger. Thanks to you, this danger has abated.
rows.quest:25:obj:0: Dispatch 12 Befouled Water Elementals at Mystral Lake, due east of the Talondeep Path and southwest of Splintertree Post.
rows.quest:25:obj:1: BScout the gazebo on Mystral Lake that overlooks the nearby ⟦E3⟧ outpost.
rows.quest:25:obj:2: BReturn to Mastok Wrilehiss at Splintertree Post, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:25:details:0: If you want to be useful, then why don't you do something about the situation near Talondeep Path?
rows.quest:25:details:1: BThe transports between ⟦E2⟧ and Stonetalon are at a standstill because of the lake coming alive and attacking anything that gets close... which means anyone on the path. What'd be even more useful than just putting the hammer down on the water elementals there is someone scouting the gazebo on Mystral Lake - the one that has a solid view of the ⟦E3⟧ outpost there.
rows.quest:25:completion:0: Yeah, I heard that someone tore up the lake out there like a dust devil through the ⟦E4⟧. From the sound of it too, we might be able to set up a possible observation area out there to keep an eye on our ⟦E3⟧ friends. Well, that is if we can keep it on the down low...
rows.quest:25:completion:1: BLooks like you ended up being quite useful after all; the transports between here and Stonetalon should have an easier time of it. Take this - you've earned it.
rows.quest:216:obj:0: Take down 8 Thistlefur Avengers and 8 Thistlefur ⟦E5⟧; most are located east of Zoram Strand in Thistlefur Village. Once completed, return to Karang Amakkar at Zoram'gar Outpost, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:216:details:0: The Thistlefur furbolgs are threatening our expansion! Thistlefur Village to our east blocks the way between us here and the Splintertree Post. It's a path that would circumvent the village of Astranaar; without it, we give the ⟦E3⟧ an extra expansion path.
rows.quest:216:details:1: B⟦4⟧, we must not allow... an expansion path gap!
rows.quest:216:details:2: BProceed to Thistlefur Village and thin out the furbolgs. You will be given compensation for this task, but more importantly you will be doing your duty for the ⟦E6⟧!
rows.quest:216:completion:0: Well done ⟦5⟧, well done! I will continue to send forces to thin out the furbolg, but I can at least count on a different path that will be free of ⟦E3⟧ entanglements. The ⟦E6⟧ conquest of ⟦E2⟧ is now in full swing!
rows.quest:216:completion:1: BYou've earned your pay this day, hero. I salute you!
rows.quest:247:completion:0: ⟦6⟧, you have slain all three beasts that comprise the ⟦E2⟧ Hunt. You have brought me adequate proof of their demise; there is no question of your strength and tenacity. The blood of a hunter streaks through your veins, and you should be commended!
rows.quest:247:completion:1: BPlease, accept this bauble as a sign of congratulations on your mighty deeds done in ⟦E2⟧ for the ⟦E6⟧ today. May your ancestors watch over you!
rows.quest:824:obj:0: Bring the Befouled Water Globe to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:824:details:0: The ⟦E7⟧ is a shamanistic group dedicated to studying and preserving the elements. They have forgotten more about crazy old gods, ancient legends and lore than most scholars will ever know.
rows.quest:824:details:1: BLucky for you, I know someone in the ⟦E7⟧ here in ⟦E2⟧. Head over to Zoram'gar Outpost on the coast of the Zoram Strand; show Je'neu Sancrea what you found. If anyone can figure out that globe's significance, it'd be him.
rows.quest:824:completion:0: This globe... it is most disturbing. Many of the more powerful elementals receive their power and energy through such devices. To find one like this nearly intact is one thing - to find it so tainted is another.
rows.quest:824:completion:1: BI will see that this globe is studied properly by the ⟦E7⟧. Perhaps we can bring an end to this corruption of the elements. Please - accept this as a fair exchange for bringing this globe to the attention of the ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:976:obj:0: Speak with Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post after seeing Feero safely through ⟦E2⟧ Forest.
rows.quest:976:details:0: Delgren has asked me to deliver messages and supplies to Sentinel Starbreeze in Auberdine, but I am loathe to leave on my own. Dangerous foes operate in the forest, and I do not wish to risk letting these supplies and information fall into the wrong hands.
rows.quest:976:details:1: BIf you and others could act as my guards, I could leave now. With your protection, I have no doubt that we can see these goods safely to Auberdine.
rows.quest:976:completion:0: You have done well today, ⟦7⟧. The items we sent to aid Auberdine will be of immediate use in dealing with the dark threats that infest the forest.
rows.quest:976:completion:1: BTake these with my heartfelt thanks.
rows.quest:990:details:0: ⟦8⟧, my mistress, Raene Wolfrunner, awaits you in the city of Astranaar within ⟦E2⟧. With your help, perhaps we can at least ease some of the corruption that's taken hold there.
rows.quest:990:details:1: BHead south from here and stay close to the road--you'll find your way there without issue if you follow those directions.
rows.quest:990:completion:0: Ah, a ⟦9⟧ from ⟦E8⟧. Selarin has done well to send you here so quickly, ⟦10⟧. I wish your trip here wasn't under such dire stress. Perhaps with your help we can improve matters.
rows.quest:990:completion:1: BI would start my visit by speaking to the other citizens of Astranaar. Some could surely use your aid.
rows.quest:991:details:0: ⟦11⟧, a longtime friend of mine is also aiding the Sentinels here in ⟦E2⟧, but he has yet to return.
rows.quest:991:details:1: BHe had leads on finding an item that he thought could slow the furbolg attacks on our people--a rod created by a now-dead, evil wizard.
rows.quest:991:details:2: BBefore he left here, he mentioned seeking out a gem for the rod.
rows.quest:991:details:3: BHe mentioned the gem possibly being hidden at the shrine in Lake Falathim at the base of the mountain to the west. The gem was being held there before it was overrun.
rows.quest:991:completion:0: Teronis' body lies broken atop the island. For some unknown reason, the murlocs have left it alone.
rows.quest:991:completion:1: BThe deep slashes across his corpse obviously came from the weapons and claws of the murlocs.
rows.quest:1007:obj:0: Bring the Ancient Statuette to Talen, in his camp near the Zoram Strand.
rows.quest:1007:details:0: I would charge you with a task, ⟦13⟧.
rows.quest:1007:details:1: BI was on my small vessel, skimming over the submerged ruins of Zoram, when naga attacked me, surging from the water and tearing at me with their claws! I fled, carrying what supplies I could to make this meager camp.
rows.quest:1007:details:2: BBut when I reached the shore and ran... my prized possession was lost.
rows.quest:1007:details:3: BPlease, ⟦14⟧, find the site of my ambush, along the coast to the north, and search for an ancient statuette. It is the reason I have braved the dangers of the Zoram Strand.
rows.quest:1007:completion:1: BThe old city of Zoram holds many secrets, and this statuette may be the key to many of them.
rows.quest:1008:obj:0: Bring 20 Wrathtail Heads to Shindrell Swiftfire in Astranaar.
rows.quest:1008:details:0: There is evil lurking on our northwestern coast, known as the Zoram Strand.
rows.quest:1008:details:1: BIt is the resting place of the doomed city of Zoram, destroyed during the Sundering and submerged beneath the seas. It has been lost to the night elves for ages. Lost, and nearly forgotten.
rows.quest:1008:details:2: BNow, the naga have returned, and for what reason we do not know. But reason matters little; we must slay these fiends and throw them back to the depths!
rows.quest:1008:details:3: BReturn to me when your mission is complete.
rows.quest:1008:completion:0: Very well done, ⟦16⟧. Your actions in the Zoram Strand against the naga are commendable.
rows.quest:1008:completion:1: BI know your feat was not easily accomplished, for the strength and guile of the naga is well known to the night elves. We know this, for we share a history with them.
rows.quest:1008:completion:2: BIt is a history I care not to repeat.
rows.quest:1009:obj:0: Bring the Ring of Zoram to Talen near the Zoram Strand.
rows.quest:1009:details:0: I fear the ancient statuette's secrets will remain forever hidden unless you find the key to its ancient lock.
rows.quest:1009:details:1: BThat key is a ring, the Ring of Zoram. It belonged to the rulers of this city before the waves of the Sundering drowned it.
rows.quest:1009:details:2: BFor years the ring was lost, but the naga have recently found it.
rows.quest:1009:details:3: BTheir leader, Ruuzel, dwells on an isle on the northern edge of Zoram. Please, ⟦17⟧, retrieve the ring for me!
rows.quest:1009:completion:0: You found the ring! Thank you, ⟦18⟧. Please take this as payment, and know that your deeds today will remain forever in my memory.
rows.quest:1010:obj:0: Bring 5 Bathran's Hair to Orendil Broadleaf in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1010:details:0: There is a plant that once grew in the old ruins of Bathran's Haunt to the north. The plant was called Bathran's Hair and was known to cure ailments of the spirit.
rows.quest:1010:details:1: BThere is a sick child in the village, and I believe it is more than just a physical illness. Will you go to Bathran's Haunt and search it for Bathran's Hair? I may need it to properly treat the child.
rows.quest:1010:details:2: BBathran's Haunt lies north of Maestra's Post and just south of the border to ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:1010:completion:0: Ah, you have the hair! Now I will mix a cure for the child, and pray my concoction works.
rows.quest:1010:completion:1: BAnd... ⟦E9⟧ are at Bathran's Haunt? Very troubling to hear, that is. Very troubling indeed...
rows.quest:1011:obj:0: Bring a Bottle of Disease to Kayneth Stillwind in Forest Song.
rows.quest:1011:details:0: The ⟦E9⟧, the undead arm of the ⟦E6⟧, have crept into ⟦E2⟧, lurking at our ruins and our barrows. We believe their goal is to spread disease amongst the lands of the night elves. We must confirm this!
rows.quest:1011:details:1: BThe ⟦E9⟧ have a camp south of here, near the Dor'Danil Barrow Den, where they create poisons and diseases and place them in bottles. Fight your way into that camp and steal a bottle of disease. Return with such a bottle. I will test it and find its purpose.
rows.quest:1011:completion:0: Very good, ⟦19⟧. Now... by testing the contents of this bottle, the goals of the ⟦E9⟧ will be revealed!
rows.quest:1012:obj:0: Kill the druids: Taneel Darkwood, Uthil Mooncall, Mavoris Cloudsbreak; then return to Kayneth Stillwind in Forest Song.
rows.quest:1012:details:0: When I struggled with the ⟦E9⟧'s poisons, I had a vision. I had a vision of the druids in the Dor'danil Barrow Den, poisoned... murdered by the undead! They are now errant ghosts, severed from their bodies and driven mad.
rows.quest:1012:details:1: BSo that the druids' spirits might some day find peace, you must enter the Dor'danil Barrow Den and destroy its once great leaders: Taneel Darkwood, Uthil Mooncall and Mavoris Cloudsbreak.
rows.quest:1012:details:2: BDo this, then return to me.
rows.quest:1012:completion:0: I felt the anguish of the Dor'danil Barrows lessen, and knew you had completed your task.
rows.quest:1012:completion:1: BIt was grim work you did, ⟦20⟧, for the spirits you destroyed were merely victims of the ⟦E9⟧'s evil. But with their destruction, let us hope the other maddened spirits find peace.
rows.quest:1016:obj:0: Collect 5 Intact Elemental Bracers and use the Divining Scroll on them. Afterwards, bring the Divined Scroll to Sentinel Velene Starstrike at the Silverwind Refuge.
rows.quest:1016:details:0: Take this divining scroll--it can determine the creator of these elementals. But you will need something from them to use as a reagent to focus scroll's magic--their bracers should do nicely.
rows.quest:1016:details:1: BA few intact bracers from the creatures should be enough. The other bracers will be useless for our purposes, but they may be worth something to a merchant if you wish to sell them. Once you have the intact bracers attempt to use the scroll. Return to me with the results and we shall proceed from there.
rows.quest:1016:completion:0: Well done, ⟦21⟧, this should give us the information we need to have the culprit discovered. How would you feel about taking out the mage who fills our pools with corrupt elementals? The corruption of ⟦E2⟧ and beyond makes my stomach turn on its own--to have a wizard actively attempting to destroy it further sickens me to no end. We shall make him pay.
rows.quest:1017:obj:0: Slay Sarilus Foulborne and bring his head to Sentinel Velene Starstrike in Silverwind Refuge.
rows.quest:1017:details:0: There's only one undead mage in the ⟦E4⟧ capable of defiling this many water elementals. He's also the only one foolish enough to try. Sarilus Foulborne is probably sitting at the top of ⟦E10⟧, laughing at me.
rows.quest:1017:details:1: B⟦22⟧, you must go into enemy territory and destroy this miscreant. I have had enough of his idiocy and we must show him what happens to those who annoy the Sentinels.
rows.quest:1017:details:2: BDestroy him and bring me his head. Be wary though, the ⟦E6⟧ may be watching for you.
rows.quest:1017:completion:0: Now I can see that repugnant smile wiped from his face forever. You have done very well, ⟦23⟧. Take this, the Light of ⟦E11⟧, drink of it when all seems lost and death is near. It may save you, Goddess willing.
rows.quest:1020:obj:0: Bring Orendil's Cure to Pelturas Whitemoon in Astranaar.
rows.quest:1020:details:0: ⟦24⟧, I have created a cure that I believe will help the afflicted child. Take it to Astranaar and give it to the child's parent, Pelturas Whitemoon.
rows.quest:1020:details:1: BTo reach Astranaar, follow the road south, then east.
rows.quest:1020:completion:1: BHis skill with herbs and healing is great. This cure gives me hope, when before I had little...
rows.quest:1021:details:0: Listen, I don't know who you are, but I need your help. My sisters went to take back the Branch of Cenarius from the satyr. They said they'd be back soon, but it's been two whole days!
rows.quest:1021:details:1: B⟦25⟧, you have to find them! They were looking for the ruins of a night elf temple in Xavian to the northwest. I don't know what to think. Look for Anilia, she was leading them on the search.
rows.quest:1021:completion:0: Judging by the gaping wound in her side, Anilia is on the verge of death.
rows.quest:1022:obj:0: Go to the Howling Vale and study the Tome of Mel'Thandris, then return to Sentinel Melyria Frostshadow at Forest Song.
rows.quest:1022:details:0: Though we have put many resources and much effort into driving the remaining demons from the ⟦E12⟧ to the north, our successes have been few. We have been able to keep much of the demonic presence from ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1022:details:1: BTo the north, near the ⟦E12⟧ border, the ruined shrine of Mel'Thandris has been overtaken by mysterious wolf-men. Their chilling calls have led the area to be known as the Howling Vale. The Tome of Mel'Thandris kept at the shrine may shed some light on why these wolf-men have come.
rows.quest:1022:completion:0: The Tome of Mel'Thandris works in strange ways. The events it records, the events it shows... No one truly understands why it does what it does.
rows.quest:1022:completion:1: BNonetheless, it is clear that what Priestess Starsong received--this Scythe of ⟦E11⟧--bears further investigation.
rows.quest:1023:obj:0: Find the Glowing Gem and return to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar with Teronis' Journal.
rows.quest:1023:details:0: As you rummage through Teronis' belongings, you find a journal that is still in good condition.
rows.quest:1023:details:1: BYou take the journal and leave Teronis' corpse as is.
rows.quest:1023:details:2: BThe only thing left to do is find the gem Teronis was seeking. Raene mentioned it being in the area. Perhaps the murlocs have it...
rows.quest:1023:completion:0: This is terrible, ⟦26⟧. Teronis is dead?!
rows.quest:1023:completion:1: BThe time for mourning will come, but for now we must focus our efforts. I shall send some of the Sentinels to recover Teronis' body as soon as possible.
rows.quest:1023:completion:2: BYou have Teronis' journal and the gem he was seeking. Do you think you're capable of completing his task? I would rest much better knowing his death was not in vain.
rows.quest:1024:obj:0: Find Shael'dryn at the moonwell to the northeast.
rows.quest:1024:details:0: You'll have to do the research yourself, but from what notes Teronis has made, it sounds like your next course of action is to find the other pieces of the rod Dartol created. I would start by heading to the moonwell east of Iris Lake. When you're ready, follow the road and turn north when you reach a small sitting area on your left.
rows.quest:1024:details:1: BA dryad there named Shael'dryn is better suited to guide you. Seek her out.
rows.quest:1024:details:2: BKeep the gem with you--Shael'dryn will need it if she's to help you recreate the rod.
rows.quest:1024:completion:0: Oh, Raene sent you? It must be serious indeed. What can I help you with?
rows.quest:1025:obj:0: Kill 1 Den Watcher, 2 Ursas, 10 Totemics, and 12 Warriors of the Foulweald tribe, and then return to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar.
rows.quest:1025:details:0: Before you travel to the moonwell I have another task that will aid the people of ⟦E2⟧ if you would like to test your skills.
rows.quest:1025:details:1: BAlong the road heading east before the Falfarren River, furbolgs have been attacking travelers. Their tortured minds feeding upon fear, and their appetites satiated by the blood of innocents.
rows.quest:1025:details:2: BAid the Sentinels in protecting the lands by showing those monsters the same mercy they have shown our kind.
rows.quest:1025:details:3: BI believe their camps are south of the road... be careful.
rows.quest:1025:completion:0: You have done well, ⟦27⟧. Thank you.
rows.quest:1026:obj:0: Find the Wooden Key and a piece of Dartol's Rod before returning to Shael'dryn at the moonwell.
rows.quest:1026:details:0: I wish your tidings were better.
rows.quest:1026:details:1: BRaene is correct, I know about Dartol's creation and the treants in the area--at least I did once. They've become corrupted now, their nature twisted.
rows.quest:1026:details:2: BIf your goal is to find the next piece of the rod, then you'll have to find the key to open the chest it's in.
rows.quest:1026:details:3: BThe wooden key is on one of the treants northeast of here, near ⟦E12⟧. Once you have it, look for a small glade west of the road near the ⟦E12⟧ border... the chest should be hidden around there.
rows.quest:1026:completion:0: I'm pleased to see you're back, ⟦28⟧.
rows.quest:1027:obj:0: Find the final piece of Dartol's Rod and return to Shael'dryn at the moonwell.
rows.quest:1027:details:0: The final piece of the rod was given to the druids of Dor'danil for safekeeping. I have no idea where they hid it. I'm sorry I can't help you more than that.
rows.quest:1027:details:1: BAll I can tell you is to follow the road that leads towards the ⟦E4⟧. The druids took shelter to the east of that road, but they won't be of much help to you: they were killed recently... it's something I don't like to think about much.
rows.quest:1027:details:2: BWhen you find the final piece, bring it to me and I will help you reconstruct the rod.
rows.quest:1027:completion:0: You found the final piece? Wonderful for you... and for Raene.
rows.quest:1027:completion:1: BI guess we'll have to see about repairing it, won't we?
rows.quest:1028:obj:0: Find the hidden shrine and re-enchant Dartol's Rod.
rows.quest:1028:details:0: Here is the completed rod, ⟦29⟧. Reconstructing it was simple... it's finding the shrine that has the power to recharge it that will be the hard part.
rows.quest:1028:details:1: BWith some focus and effort it shouldn't be too hard for someone like you, who's already accomplished so much.
rows.quest:1028:details:2: BHead southeast of here--there are very few paths, so be careful--and keep your eyes to the north. The shrine is hidden within the mountains that surround this glade.
rows.quest:1028:details:3: BOnce there, place the rod within the shrine... the rest is magic. Hehe.
rows.quest:1028:completion:0: After the glow dies, you can see the re-enchanted rod within the shrine's basin.
rows.quest:1029:obj:0: Return to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar.
rows.quest:1029:details:0: I suggest you find Raene and let her know the rod is finished. I'm sure she'll know what your next course should be.
rows.quest:1029:completion:0: You've recreated the rod Teronis had set out to find? That's wonderful to hear.
rows.quest:1029:completion:1: BTeronis would be proud to see his quest is continuing even after his tragic passing.
rows.quest:1030:obj:0: Find an uncorrupted furbolg, and using the power of Dartol's Rod of Transformation, speak to him.
rows.quest:1030:details:0: Alas, I'm not completely certain what he had in mind next.
rows.quest:1030:details:1: BIf what he said was true about the rod's power, then it will allow you to take on another form altogether. Which form, I do not know.
rows.quest:1030:details:2: BPerhaps he meant to use its powers to get closer to the tainted furbolgs, but even the uncorrupted creatures would slaughter him were he not careful. Transformed by the rod, Dartol would have to speak to a furbolg who was safe from the effects of Fel Moss.
rows.quest:1030:details:3: BI would start your search southeast of Mystral Lake.
rows.quest:1030:completion:0: Yes, yes... you are one of my kind, but still whole. Still clean.
rows.quest:1030:completion:1: BI am unsure how you have escaped the atrocities the night elves have visited upon our people, but I am glad to know that I am no longer alone.
rows.quest:1030:completion:2: BCorruption now runs through the veins of our kin, young one, corruption brought down upon us by the prideful night elves. They are the ones who did this to our people... They are the ones I blame for being cast out of my tribe.
rows.quest:1030:completion:3: BAt night I can still see the campfires burning in the darkness.
rows.quest:1031:obj:0: Kill Geltharis and return the Branch of Cenarius to Illiyana at Forest Song.
rows.quest:1031:details:0: Anilia puts her hands on your shoulders and draws you close. Gasping, she points towards the arch to the north, before her eyes close and her last wheezing breath leaves her body. "He has taken it... Geltharis..." You know in your heart that Anilia's dying wish is to see the Branch of Cenarius back in dryad hands.
rows.quest:1031:completion:0: Anilia died? No... that can't be! It was just yesterday that we were running and playing together in the woods.
rows.quest:1031:completion:1: BI guess those days are over...
rows.quest:1032:obj:0: Bring 16 Satyr Horns to Illiyana in Forest Song.
rows.quest:1032:details:0: I can't believe that Anilia is gone... We used to play together in the forests all the time. I almost feel... sad.
rows.quest:1032:details:1: BI know something that might make me feel better. Please, slay the satyrs that took Anilia from me! Bring me their horns as proof of your actions and you will forever have my gratitude.
rows.quest:1032:completion:0: Thank you, kind ⟦31⟧. My sister's spirit is gladdened by your efforts.
rows.quest:1033:obj:0: Bring ⟦E11⟧'s Tear to Pelturas in Astranaar.
rows.quest:1033:details:0: I had hoped Orendil's cure would save Relara, but I fear it only slowed the disease running through my child. We must find more powerful medicine! Thankfully, Orendil spoke to me of further remedies to try should his first one fail.
rows.quest:1033:details:1: BElune's Tear is a type of stone that rests in only one place: the isle on Iris Lake, east of Astranaar. Orendil said the stone will wash away corruption... please, ⟦32⟧, bring me ⟦E11⟧'s Tear and pray it will end my child's sickness!
rows.quest:1033:completion:0: Oh, you found it! I will place the tear in a stew, and pray that it will cure her.
rows.quest:1034:obj:0: Bring 5 Handfuls of Stardust to Pelturas in Astranaar.
rows.quest:1034:details:0: ⟦E11⟧'s Tear washed clear some of my daughter's sickness. Her nightmares are lessened and I thank the goddess for her blessing. But ... fever still rages within her.
rows.quest:1034:details:1: BOrendil told me of a frosted dust found among the Ruins of Stardust. Perhaps it will abate Relara's fever. Gather some of the dust, then please return to me.
rows.quest:1034:details:2: BThe Ruins of Stardust lie to the south, ⟦34⟧. May ⟦E11⟧ speed your journey.
rows.quest:1034:completion:0: You gathered the dust! I will create a poultice from these -- it should bring down Relara's fever.
rows.quest:1034:completion:1: BThank you again, ⟦35⟧. Without your help, my child would surely perish.
rows.quest:1035:obj:0: Retrieve a Fallen Moonstone from the Shadethicket Oracle, then bring it to Pelturas in Astranaar.
rows.quest:1035:details:0: Relara's fever has passed, but she is still very weak. I do not believe time alone will give her back the strength she has lost. I believe it will take the power of a moonstone.
rows.quest:1035:details:1: BWe used to gather moonstones at Fallen Sky Lake to the southeast... until the Shadethickets came.
rows.quest:1035:details:2: BTheir leader, a Shadethicket Oracle, gathered up all the fallen moonstones and hoards them. Now, you must retrieve a moonstone from the Oracle.
rows.quest:1035:details:3: BAnd to do that, I fear that you must slay him.
rows.quest:1035:completion:0: Oh, ⟦36⟧, you have saved my daughter! I know the power of the moonstone will give back my daughter her strength!
rows.quest:1035:completion:1: BI can never repay you fully for the aid you have given me, but... please, take this. Other than Relara, it is my most dear possession.
rows.quest:1037:obj:0: Speak with Thyn'tel Bladeweaver at the Warrior's Terrace in ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:1037:details:0: Velinde Starsong was my predecessor here in ⟦E2⟧ Forest. At first it seemed she had the situation in ⟦E12⟧ under control, but little by little her efforts faltered. One day, she simply disappeared.
rows.quest:1037:details:1: BI was sent here to continue her work. I'm afraid I know nothing of the priestess, however. Perhaps Thyn'tel Bladeweaver, one of the commanders of the Sentinels, knows further details of her disappearance that I was not a party to.
rows.quest:1037:details:2: BSurely she will understand the import of such information.
rows.quest:1037:completion:0: Velinde Starsong? That the priestess disappeared some time ago is almost certainly common knowledge. As to further details about the events that surrounded her departure... it would take good reason for me to divulge such information.
rows.quest:1038:obj:0: Search through Velinde's chest for her journal, then return it along with the key to Thyn'tel Bladeweaver in ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:1038:details:0: The Tome of Mel'Thandris showed you this? I suppose there would be little harm in allowing you to examine her belongings. This key will allow you to open the chest where we stored her things in the Sentinels' bunkhouse. She kept a journal of her duties, if there is anything to be learned, it will be from that.
rows.quest:1038:details:1: BI should tell you, the Sentinels believe that she had her own reasons for leaving, and expect that she could return at any time. The priestess has done much in the past to earn our trust.
rows.quest:1038:completion:0: It seems that Velinde's disappearance is more troubling than it originally appeared. Even still, I cannot believe that she has come to a bad end. Perhaps it would be beneficial for us to make contact with her.
rows.quest:1038:completion:1: B⟦37⟧, since you have shown a vested interest in this matter, I would like to enlist your aid.
rows.quest:1039:obj:0: Speak with Wharfmaster Dizzywig in Ratchet.
rows.quest:1039:details:0: Ratchet is the only port in the ⟦E4⟧. Most likely Velinde found a trading vessel in Ratchet to take her to Blackwater Cove in ⟦E14⟧. We've had limited dealings with the goblins that run the port, but the master of the dock should have information about the comings and goings of ship passengers.
rows.quest:1039:details:1: BFollow the road southeast through ⟦E2⟧ and you will find yourself in the ⟦E4⟧. Watch your step, ⟦38⟧, warriors of the ⟦E6⟧ patrol the land. You will be safe at the port, though.
rows.quest:1039:completion:0: ⟦39⟧, eh? Must admit, we don't get much of your type out here. Looking for someone, eh? Just give me a moment, I'm sure I have it written in one of my ledgers.
rows.quest:1039:completion:1: BLot of people travel through here, though, so just give me a moment.
rows.quest:1040:obj:0: Take a boat to Booty Bay and speak with Caravaneer Ruzzgot.
rows.quest:1040:details:0: Ah yes, finally found it. Should have told me she passed through here that long ago. Let's see.
rows.quest:1040:details:1: BVelinde. Booked passage to Booty Bay on the Black Osprey. I don't have anything here saying otherwise, so I'd assume it arrived in port safely.
rows.quest:1040:details:2: BNot much more help I can be to you, but she asked about overland travel over on that side of the world, and I mentioned Ruzzgot, a caravan driver based out of Booty Bay. Might be that this Velinde traveled with him.
rows.quest:1040:details:3: BMove along, now. I haven't all day for you.
rows.quest:1040:completion:0: Yes? Now, it doesn't look to me like you're the sort with goods that need shipping, so either you're looking for a job with my caravan--and there's no jobs to be had now--or you're probably talking to the wrong goblin.
rows.quest:1041:obj:0: Speak with Clerk Daltry in Darkshire.
rows.quest:1041:details:0: Turns out I was wrong about you, and that isn't something that happens everyday.
rows.quest:1041:details:1: BIt just so happens that I remember this Velinde you're looking for. Isn't every day that a night elf priestess that wants to travel with a dirty old--but great for your shipping needs!--caravan like my own.
rows.quest:1041:details:2: BWe split up on the way north, she was headed for Darkshire. The clerk there keeps all sorts of records. Might know something useful.
rows.quest:1041:details:3: BBe careful in the jungle, it is a deadly place even at the best of times.
rows.quest:1041:completion:0: With all the strange happenings of the last few years, I keep as good records of strangers as I can. Never know when it might come in handy... though it's usually not pleasant business when it does. Not to suggest anything about this Velinde you're looking for.
rows.quest:1042:obj:0: Speak with Jonathan Carevin in Darkshire.
rows.quest:1042:details:0: No, I don't have any records of a Velinde Starsong staying in Darkshire... though, if you don't mind me saying, I can hardly imagine a night elf priestess taking a room in the inn, if you get my meaning?
rows.quest:1042:details:1: BThese wolf-men you mentioned though, that's something I've heard about. Just the other day, Calor came into town with a string of their heads. He works with the Carevin family. Hunters of demons, undead, and other monstrosities. Speak with Jonathan, he's the head of the household.
rows.quest:1042:completion:0: Dark times these are. Ill news is whispered from every swaying branch, and evil can be found under every rock.
rows.quest:1042:completion:1: BAnd in such times an unknown stranger enters my home and asks of worgen... I'll ask no forgiveness for my suspicions, only answers.
